sock_paths.description: List of Unix socket paths where gssproxy will accept client connections.

debug_level.description: Debug verbosity level (0 = quiet, 1 = normal, 2 = verbose, 3 = debug).

use_socket_activation.description: If true, gssproxy will use systemd socket activation instead of binding sockets itself.

ccache_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which a credential cache entry is considered expired.

ecosystem_enabled.description: Enable support for ecosystem extensions (e.g., integration with SSSD, Kerberos, etc.).

name.description: Unique name for this mechanism (used as section header in config).

oid.description: GSS mechanism OID in dotted decimal notation.

keytab.description: Path to the keytab file containing service keys.

ccache.description: Default credential cache location for this mechanism.

allowed_enctypes.description: List of encryption types allowed for this mechanism (e.g., aes256-cts-hmac-sha1-96).

client_principal.description: Optional client principal to use when initiating GSS context.

credentials_cache.description: Credential cache path for server-side use.

euid.description: Effective UID used when accessing credentials (for file-backed caches).

mechanisms.description: List of GSS mechanisms (e.g., Kerberos) to support, each with its own configuration.

principal.description: Source principal (e.g., 'nfs@OLD realm') to be emulated.

target.description: Target principal it should map to (e.g., 'nfs@REALM').

emulated_principals.description: List of principal emulations to support legacy client requests.

trusted_principals.description: List of principals (with realm) that are trusted to use delegated credentials.

trusted_dirs.description: List of directories whose contents (e.g., keytabs) are trusted for reading.
